You can't use SSH to access any of the nodes in your OpenSearch cluster, and you can't directly
modify opensearch.yml. Instead, use the console, AWS CLI, or SDKs to conﬁgure your domain.
You can specify a few cluster-level settings using the OpenSearch REST APIs, as well. To learn
more, see the Amazon OpenSearch Service API Reference and the section called “Supported
operations”.
If you need more insight into the performance of the cluster, you can publish error logs and slow
logs to CloudWatch.
